description: Use this to merge a supplied handoff BOM with optional KernelCAD catalog parts, MPNs and pricing, write a local CSV, and return Sheets-ready rows. Pass exactly one of handoff, handoff_json or handoff_path. The default output is a new file under artifacts/bom; an explicit output_path selects another allowed destination. Existing files are preserved unless overwrite:true, which replaces the destination. This tool makes no Google API calls.

catalog_parts.description: Optional matching KernelCAD catalog entries with id/ref, partNumber, vendor and price.

handoff.description: Handoff object with a parts array.

output_path.description: Optional CSV destination. Defaults to artifacts/bom/bom-<id>.csv.

overwrite.description: Set true to replace an existing CSV destination. Existing files are otherwise preserved.

name: write_bom
title: Write Bill of Materials
